widget.description: Complete text widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. No data source. Rich text lives in parameters.content as Quill-Delta ops. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key within the dashboard, e.g. "text_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions (navigate, run a flow, set a parameter, set a filter, record action). Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

content.description: Quill-Delta ops list. Each op is { insert, attributes? }. Plain text ends with a trailing "\n".

attributes.description: Inline formatting for the inserted text.

rules.description: Echoed back by the server on each op even if you didn't send one — harmless, don't be surprised reading it back.

overflow.description: How content overflowing the widget's bounds is handled.

wrap.description: Whether text wraps within the widget.

receiveFilterSource.description: Which published filters this widget listens to. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/receiveSources/receiveFilterSource.

receiveParameterSource.description: Which published parameters this widget listens to. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/receiveSources/receiveParameterSource.

conditionalFormattingRules.description: Rules that restyle content based on a bucketed value. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/conditionalFormatting.
